How Google DeepMind Evolved, 2021–2026

From Gopher, Chinchilla and AlphaCode to Gemini 1 through 4, open Gemma models, Veo and Nano Banana, coding agents, world models and maths gold medals. Every Google DeepMind announcement this site tracks, laid out in seven lanes. Press play to watch it grow, hide lanes, or tap a dot for the summary and source.

Tap a dot

Each dot is one announcement. Big dots are flagship releases. The coloured bands behind are the four phases.

Dates, titles and summaries come from this site’s Frontier Lab Updates data, each with a link to its source. The lanes and the four phases are our grouping. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site. Google is an investor in Anthropic and also a competitor.
